subject: Anthropic IPO tests Europe’s AI boom

stories.headline: Anthropic debuted on Nasdaq, raising about $81.3bn in the largest IPO in history
stories.quote: Raising about $81.3bn in its listing — the largest IPO in history — Anthropic popped in early trading amid big investor demand.

facts.text: Anthropic officially debuted on New York's Nasdaq the day before the issue.
facts.quote: Over 4,000 miles away from New York’s Nasdaq stock exchange, seemingly everyone in Helsinki has been talking about Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO. The AI model maker officially debuted yesterday, giving the public market its first taste of a frontier AI startup.

facts.text: Raised about $81.3bn in its listing, described as the largest IPO in history; shares popped in early trading.
facts.quote: Raising about $81.3bn in its listing — the largest IPO in history — Anthropic popped in early trading amid big investor demand.

facts.text: Priced at $83 per share; reports put the valuation at $1.4tn before pricing. Menlo Ventures' Deedy Das reckons that is probably too low.
facts.quote: reckons a $1.4tn valuation, which reports put its valuation before it priced at $83 per share, is probably too low.

facts.text: Menlo Ventures partner Deedy Das said the short-term market impact does not faze him.
facts.quote: “The short-term impact on the market, honestly, doesn’t faze me that much,” Das told me on Wednesday of the IPO.

stories.headline: Plural announced a €1bn third fund, its largest
stories.quote: London- and Tallinn-based Plural raised €1bn for its third fund. The fund will focus on early-stage “non-obvious” companies .

facts.text: The fund is Plural's third and largest, and one of the biggest such vehicles in Europe.
facts.quote: London- and Tallinn-based VC firm Plural announced a whopping €1bn fund, its third and largest, and one of the biggest such vehicles in Europe.

stories.headline: Sofinnova Partners raised €725m for its second crossover fund
stories.quote: Paris-based VC Sofinnova Partners raised €725m for its second crossover fund. The firm focuses on late-stage life sciences companies.

stories.headline: Drone maker UForce, a Menlo Ventures portfolio company, just raised $700m
stories.quote: In Europe, Menlo has backed vibe coding startup Lovable and drone maker UForce, which just raised $700m.

stories.headline: European hardware startups have raised €26.9bn in equity so far this year, 51% more than all of 2025
stories.quote: European startups developing hardware have raised €26.9bn in equity funding so far this year, 51% more than in the whole of 2025, according to Sifted data. That’s 38% of all VC money raised in Europe this year.

facts.text: Prototype Capital's Andreas Klinger called the tech market a bubble and advised founders to raise while they can.
facts.quote: “My advice to founders is get money while you can,” Klinger told the audience at Slush. “It's 100% a bubble,” he said of what's happening in the tech market right now.

stories.headline: Sequoia Capital has pulled the plug on its European office in London
stories.quote: And can US VCs really run a European office, now that fellow Silicon Valley firm Sequoia has pulled the plug on its own?

facts.text: The issue refers to Sequoia Capital uprooting from London.
